verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents user-managed storage that the user controls directly. Volumes persist beyond instance destruction until the user manages them via the Storage page, and the CLI workflow includes an explicit 'clean up' step. This implies the user decides when data is kept or removed, but the evidence never explicitly describes deleting data or any retention policy. Missing for 10: an explicit documented deletion of volume or instance data, retention policies or settings, guarantees that data is wiped from host machines after rental ends, account-level data deletion, and independent corroboration.
